task_spec: Implement percentile(data, p) with linear interpolation matching numpy's default: the rank position is (N-1) * p/100, interpolating between the two surrounding order statistics. percentile([0,10,20,30], 50) must be 15.0.

bugs.description: The rank uses len(s) * p/100 but the linear method requires (len(s)-1) * p/100. With N elements the interpolation index must span 0..N-1, not 0..N. percentile([0,10,20,30], 50) returns 20.0 with this code instead of the correct 15.0, and the error grows toward the high end (p=75 gives 30 instead of 22.5).

provenance.note: subtle bug requiring reasoning/domain knowledge to catch
